original.value: A soft anime-style bedroom portrait of {argument name="character name" default="Nekomata Okayu"}, shown from the chest up sitting on a bed at night, centered in the frame. She has short fluffy {argument name="hair color" default="lavender"} hair with layered bangs partially covering one eye, large cat ears on top of her head with white inner fur, and a cute sleepy catgirl appearance. Her expression is gentle and relaxed, with one hand raised near her cheek in a shy, cozy pose. She wears oversized {argument name="pajama color" default="light lavender"} button-up pajamas with dark purple piping, a small chest pocket, and paw-print shaped buttons and paw-print decoration on the pocket. The room is lit with dreamy purple ambient lighting. In the background, show a nighttime window with a crescent moon and stars visible outside, soft curtains, a bedside table with a glowing cat-shaped lamp, a neatly rumpled bed with pillows and blankets in matching purple tones, and a small framed wall picture featuring a simple cat face and hearts. Use a cute pastel palette, soft shading, polished digital anime rendering, subtle highlights in the hair, intimate cozy composition, and a calm bedtime atmosphere.

zh-CN.value: 一个柔和的动漫风格卧室肖像，展示{argument name="character name" default="Nekomata Okayu"}从胸部以上的形象，夜晚坐在床上，位于画面中央。她有短而蓬松的{argument name="hair color" default="lavender"}色分层刘海头发，部分遮住一只眼睛，头顶上有大猫耳朵，内侧是白色绒毛，外观是可爱的睡意猫娘。她的表情温柔放松，一只手抬到脸颊附近，做出害羞舒适的姿势。她穿着宽松的{argument name="pajama color" default="light lavender"}色纽扣睡衣，有深紫色镶边，一个小胸袋，以及口袋上的爪形纽扣和爪形装饰。房间用梦幻的紫色环境光照明。背景中，显示一个夜晚的窗户，外面可以看到新月和星星，柔软的窗帘，一个带发光猫形台灯的床头柜，一个整齐凌乱的床，配有匹配紫色色调的枕头和毯子，以及一面小相框墙画，上面有简单的猫脸和心形图案。使用可爱的柔和色调，柔和的阴影，精致的数码动漫渲染，头发上的微妙高光，亲密舒适的构图，以及平静的睡前氛围。
温馨的猫娘睡衣夜晚肖像
